title: Local conjugacy in prosolvable groups
summary: Lean 4 formalization of all eleven numbered results and both counterexamples in Local conjugacy in prosolvable groups, arXiv:2609.37678v1. Closed supplements of a pronilpotent normal subgroup are conjugate exactly when locally conjugate under the stated structural hypotheses. Continuous nonabelian cohomology has the stated primary restriction decomposition. Local inclusion and fixed-point results, the GL(2,3) quaternion counterexample, and the order-162 Heisenberg wreath-product counterexample are formalized.

review.reason: Lean formalization of results on local conjugacy in prosolvable groups.
